comparator.name: Comparator library + ComparatorWorker
comparator.note: Pinned at 57567492 (merge of upstream PR #75 on master), which a plain clone can fetch. Only Comparator/{Util,Axioms,Compare}.lean are built, together with lean4export's Export/Parse.lean at the exporter commit; these files are byte-identical at 57567492 and at 14b5039e, the unmerged PR #78 head that the research harness used. Upstream Main.lean (landrun sandbox, Linux only) is not used.
